name: Behringer PRO-800
description: Behringer PRO-800 8-voice analog polyphonic synthesizer: every controller of its quick start guide's MIDI table, with the values it prints.

sources.title: PRO-800 Quick Start Guide, V 4.0
sources.notes: MIDI controller table (pages 54, 55) read by tools/profiles/behringer/read-behringer-cc.mjs from QSG_BE_0718-ABF_PRO-800_WW.pdf (sha256 3661b6bd40fa523d80534e1b49b106c2611b7d054d781d1c18a97dae57a658b5), https://cdn-media.empowertribe.com/d070b1451258414fa134b8f71b75b18c/QSG_BE_0718-ABF_PRO-800_WW.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/behringer/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/behringer/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI controller table, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Ranges are as printed (`0 - 99`): the guide does not say whether a range is the controller's values or what the panel shows for them.
Rows the guide prints wrongly, given by the layout: CC 49 (printed OSC A Saw, as 48 is: OSC A Tri), CC 52 (printed OSB B Tri), CC 53 (printed OSB B Square).
Hex column misprints, the decimal taken: CC 79 printed AF.

Left out, controllers that only have their MIDI standard meaning here: CC 0 Bank sel, CC 1 Mod Wheel, CC 2 Breath, CC 3 Master Tune, CC 6 NRPN Data MSB, CC 7 Main volume, CC 38 NRPN Data LSB, CC 64 Sustain pedal, CC 96 NRPN Data increment, CC 97 NRPN Data decrement, CC 98 NRPN Param LSB, CC 99 NRPN Param MSB, CC 120 All sounds off, CC 123 All notes off.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its MIDI settings allow
